# ISMRM Archive

> A comprehensive archive of International Society for Magnetic Resonance in Medicine conference abstracts, presentations, and research proceedings spanning over a decade of scientific contributions to medical imaging.

The ISMRM Archive provides searchable access to conference abstract indexes, presentation videos, e-posters, and research materials from annual ISMRM meetings. It serves as a central repository for magnetic resonance imaging research and scientific presentations from the global MRI community.

## Key Topics

- ISMRM Conference
- Abstract Index
- Medical Imaging
- Magnetic Resonance
